design.name: 沙暴巨像
design.brief: The desert chapter boss: a colossal ancient sandstone Heavenly King guardian statue (天王 / 金刚力士) from a buried Dunhuang cave temple (敦煌石窟), awakened by the bandits' stolen fire. A massive carved sandstone body in the shape of a Tang Buddhist guardian: very broad shoulders and long heavy arms, carved stone Tang armour with lion-head shoulder guards and a carved belt buckle, fluttering carved stone silk ribbons (帛带) arcing over the shoulders, a fierce wrathful carved face with bulging eyes glowing ember-orange and a tall gilded crown (宝冠), a cracked chest with a glowing ember-orange fire core set in a gold cloud-scroll ring, faded Dunhuang mural paint (malachite green, cinnabar red, lapis blue) on the stone. The bandits have hung crimson war banners with the gold cloud-scroll emblem and heavy iron chains on it. Huge stone fists each with a clearly separate thumb and four thick stone fingers; broad stone feet with five blocky toes. Sand pours from its cracks.
design.weapon: no weapon; one fist raised for a ground slam
